title: claytonia megarhiza var. bellidifolia

Winter purslane is known for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving wound healing due to its high levels of antioxidants and other bioactive compounds. The bioactive constituents of winter purslane include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
